test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 25 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Haleem Khan is associated with which of the following classical dances?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Kuchipudi__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Haleem Khan is an Indian Kuchipudi dancer, performer, and movie actor, born on 10 April in Ongole of Andhra Pradesh and presently lives in Hyderabad. 
 
• Haleem has performed more than 800 dance shows across the world, as well as conducted Kuchipudi workshops overseas.
 
• Kuchipudi is one of six classical dance styles of India. Kuchipudi is indigenous to the state of Andhra Pradesh and differs from the other five classical styles by the inclusion of singing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Some other famous classical dance forms of India:
 
 
• Bharatanatyam, Tamil Nadu (Southern India).
 
• Manipuri Dance, Manipur (North-eastern India).
 
• Kathak (Northern India).
 
• Odissi Dance, Orissa (Eastern India).
 
• Kathakali.
 
• Mohiniattam.
 
• Kuchipudi (Southern India).
 
• Sattriya Dance.
